description: Look up DNS records of a name. Type ALL (the default) queries A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA; any single type can be asked for. An IP address gives its reverse DNS (PTR) lookup.

name.description: Domain name or IP address, for example example.com or _dmarc.example.com.

type.description: Record type; ALL when left out.

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS lookup
